name: Sigil
product: Sigil EPUB editor by the Sigil-Ebook project

evidence.says: The project labels its current separate macOS downloads Intel and Arm64 and requires macOS 13 or newer.
The project marks 2.8.6 as its latest release on November 9 and says the Mac builds are signed and notarized.

name: CopyQ
product: CopyQ clipboard manager by Lukas Holecek and the CopyQ project

evidence.says: Upstream marks 17.0.0 as its latest release.
The official 17.0.0 assets include the distinct CopyQ-17.0.0-macos-13-m1.dmg with asset timestamp October 6, 2026.
The maintainer identifies the release DMGs named with the m1 suffix as the M1 builds.

notes: The disabled Homebrew cask still points to 16.0.0. The upstream release provides the current Apple Silicon build.

name: Camunda Modeler
product: Camunda Desktop Modeler (Camunda)

evidence.says: Camunda publishes macOS arm64 and x64 builds of 5.53.0 in its download center on November 4, 2026.
Camunda marks 5.53.0 as its latest Desktop Modeler release.

name: texmaker
product: Texmaker, the LaTeX editor by Pascal Brachet and Joël Amblard

evidence.says: Texmaker's official download page explicitly labels the 6.0.2 Mac DMG and ZIP as ARM64 builds for macOS 11 or later.
The official file index dates both Mac 6.0.2 builds to August 11, 2026.

notes: The vendor lists 5.1.4 as the older Intel Mac build.

name: EZkeys 2
product: Toontrack EZkeys 2 standalone virtual instrument

evidence.says: Toontrack staff confirms native Apple Silicon support across the company's currently sold products.
Toontrack lists EZkeys 2 as a current product with a standalone Mac application and Apple Silicon support.
Toontrack's release notes identify 2.1.6 as the current download and date it to November 9, 2026.

limitation: Toontrack identifies the current version and confirms native support across its current lineup in separate sources.

name: PdfMetadataEditor
product: PDF Metadata Editor by Zaro

evidence.says: The upstream GitHub release metadata names v4.4.2, published October 19, 2026, and lists the arm64 macOS portable ZIP.

notes: The verified architecture applies to the explicitly labeled macOS portable ZIP.

name: Sonarr
product: Sonarr series manager by the Sonarr project

evidence.says: The upstream release metadata gives the September 16, 2026 stable release version and lists the dedicated osx-arm64-app ZIP alongside an x64 app ZIP.

name: jamovi
product: jamovi statistical desktop app by the jamovi project

evidence.says: The live November 25 Homebrew API lists official jamovi 28.18.0.0 DMGs with separate macOS arm64 and x64 download paths.
The project's release notes identify jamovi 28.18 as the Current channel release dated November 8, 2026.

notes: The developer also publishes a separately versioned Solid release channel.

name: F5Access
product: F5 Access for macOS by F5 Networks

evidence.says: F5 explicitly documents native Apple Silicon support without Rosetta for F5 Access 7.2.7.4.
F5 lists the macOS F5 Access client in the 7.2.7.4 APM release package.
The legacy macOS App Store listing directs users to F5 Downloads for current versions.

limitation: F5 provides an update timestamp for the release notes without a separate release date.
notes: Native support started in the 2.1.0 App Store build. Current macOS releases are distributed through F5 Downloads or a BIG-IP deployment.

name: DivX Player
product: DivX Player for Mac, the separate DivX 10.x app by DivX, LLC

evidence.says: DivX ended maintenance of DivX 10.x on Mac on December 30, 2025.
DivX identifies 10.8.9 as the prior Mac line and says that DivX 11.11.1 for Mac folded Player, Converter, Media Server and library into one app.
DivX offers the Mac 10.8.9 64-bit installer as a beta for Catalina and Big Sur.
Static inspection of the DMG's DivX.pkg payload found the matching DivX Player.app/Contents/MacOS/DivX Player executable for build 11.8.9.10052020 to be x86_64 only.

limitation: The vendor labels the inspected installer a beta and does not give an exact Mac release date.
notes: The final standalone build identified here was Intel-only. DivX 11 includes playback in the unified DivX Software app.

name: Black Light Pro
product: Black Light Pro by Michel Fortin

evidence.says: Michel Fortin marks Black Light Pro discontinued and offers the archived version 1.2 download.
The developer dates version 1.2 to February 13, 2020.
The official ZIP's Black Light Pro.app/Contents/MacOS/Black Light Pro is x86_64 only, with version 1.2 and the matching bundle ID in Info.plist.

notes: The final release was Intel-only and the developer merged its functions into Black Light 3.

name: BetterMouse
product: BetterMouse by the BetterMouse developer

evidence.says: The vendor lists 1.7.9092 on November 8, 2026 for Apple silicon with macOS 12 or later.
The official ZIP's BetterMouse.app/Contents/MacOS/BetterMouse contains arm64 and x86_64 slices, with version 1.7 build 9092 and the matching bundle ID in Info.plist.

name: NZBGet
product: Original NZBGet Usenet downloader by hugbug (nzbget.net)

evidence.says: GitHub marks the original NZBGet repository archived as of November 18, 2022.
The original project's final stable release is 21.1 from June 3, 2021.
The original project's Mac ZIP has the exact net.sourceforge.nzbget bundle ID and its version 21.1 NZBGet.app/Contents/MacOS/NZBGet executable is x86_64 only.
The current NZBGet.com maintainers identify their Apple Silicon-capable project as a fork of hugbug's original.

notes: The original final stable release was Intel-only. NZBGet.com is a separately maintained fork and should receive its own audit if listed.

name: OP.GG
product: OP.GG for Desktop by OP.GG

evidence.says: The vendor's official macOS update feed dates 3.4.2 to November 25 and lists the universal Mac ZIP and DMG for this exact version.
The live Homebrew API identifies OP.GG.app and provides the vendor's version 3.4.2 universal DMG.

notes: The audit version comes from the vendor's macOS updater. The public download page displayed an older version when checked.

name: M32-Edit
product: Midas M32-Edit desktop console controller by Midas / Music Tribe

evidence.says: Midas offers M32 Edit 4.4.1 for macOS in the M32 LIVE downloads.
Static inspection of M32-Edit.app/Contents/MacOS/M32-Edit from the official 4.4.1 ZIP found a universal Mach-O with arm64 and x86_64 slices.

notes: The current vendor download uses bundle ID com.Musictribe.M32-Edit, replacing the older com.music-group.M32-Edit identifier for the same M32 controller.

name: CorelCAD 2023
product: CorelCAD 2023 for macOS by Corel / Alludo

evidence.says: Corel specifies the end of renewals and the December 31, 2025 end-of-support date for CorelCAD 2023.
Corel dates its Mac 2023.5 update to December 19, 2022 and identifies build 22.3.1.4090.
Graebert confirms 2023 was the last CorelCAD release and the December 2022 service pack the last installer.
The submitted Mac app with matching 4090 build suffix and bundle ID com.corel.corelcad is reported as x86.

limitation: The matching final build is evidenced as x86 by the historical scan. Rosetta functionality was not verified.
notes: Corel ended support December 31, 2025, following the end of new licensing in January 2024. Graebert sells ARES Commander as the replacement.

name: Pandora
product: Pandora Desktop for Mac by Pandora Media

evidence.says: Pandora hosts the download entry point for its desktop client.
The current Pandora cask identifies version 16.1.0 and the vendor's universal Mac disk image.
The vendor's reachable Mac release asset explicitly identifies 16.1.0 as universal in its filename.

limitation: The artifact timestamp does not establish its public release date.

name: Shooter Suite Installer
product: Red Giant Shooter Suite 13 installer

evidence.says: The submitted bundle metadata identifies com.redgiant.Shooter-Suite-Installer and the filename identifies the Shooter Suite 13.1.3 installer.
Maxon documents that current Red Giant suites use a unified installer, distinct from the old per-suite installer.

notes: The listing represents the installer bundle, so its architecture does not describe PluralEyes or other tools installed by the suite.

name: Sonos
product: Sonos S2 desktop controller for Mac (Sonos)

evidence.says: Sonos announced that its macOS app gained native Apple Silicon support and no longer required Rosetta on August 25, 2026.
Static inspection of Sonos.app/Contents/MacOS/Sonos from the official DMG found arm64 and x86_64 in version 17.2.5 (90.0.82050) for bundle com.sonos.macController2.
A user who freshly downloaded 17.2.5 (90.0.82050) from Sonos reports both arm64 and x86_64 slices.

notes: The community thread also documents local-network discovery failures for some macOS 27 users.

name: MPEG Streamclip
product: MPEG Streamclip for Mac (Squared 5)

evidence.says: The archived version history lists 1.9.3b8 as the latest Mac beta and dates it to August 21, 2012.
The Mac software listing identifies MPEG Streamclip as 32-bit only and incompatible with Catalina or later.
Apple confirms that Catalina and later macOS releases cannot run 32-bit apps.

limitation: The latest Mac beta is documented by archives because the vendor's download page could not be reached.
notes: The last stable version listed in the archive is 1.9.2 from August 11, 2008.

name: SS-11X
product: Mercuriall Audio SS-11X standalone tube preamp simulator

evidence.says: Mercuriall's current product page lists Intel Core 2 or newer as the Mac processor requirement, identifies 1.2 as the latest SS-11X release, and documents that version 1.1 introduced the standalone app.

limitation: No vendor confirmation or direct user report verified Rosetta 2 operation for the standalone 1.2 app.

name: Screen Recorder Pro - Screen Capture HD Video
product: Screen Recorder Pro – Screen Capture HD Video by DFAV TEAM / 舒轩 魏

evidence.says: Apple's catalog confirms the exact bundle ID com.dfavteams.ScreenCompressPro and lists 3.2.3 from April 12, 2017 as the current version.
The published scan for that version and bundle ID reports x86 as its supported architecture.

limitation: The architecture is from the historical scan of the same version. No Rosetta 2 runtime report for this bundle was found.

name: Tabula
product: Tabula PDF table extractor by the TabulaPDF project

evidence.says: The project labels this build the latest release and links its Mac ZIP.
The project dates 1.2.1 to June 4, 2018 and offers a Mac package with bundled Java.
Static inspection of Tabula.app/Contents/MacOS/JavaAppLauncher in the official 1.2.1 ZIP found a thin x86_64 Mach-O for bundle org.nerdpower.tabula.Tabula.

limitation: No verified Rosetta 2 run of the bundled Mac app was found.

name: Aimersoft Video Converter Ultimate
product: Aimersoft Video Converter Ultimate for Mac by Aimersoft Studio

evidence.says: Homebrew identifies version 11.6.7.1 and explicitly states that its Intel build requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.
The former Aimersoft product page redirects to Wondershare UniConverter.
Static inspection of Aimersoft Video Converter Ultimate.app/Contents/MacOS/Aimersoft Video Converter Ultimate from the official DMG found x86_64 only in version 11.6.7.1 for the matching bundle.

limitation: Homebrew documents Rosetta 2. No vendor release date or macOS compatibility matrix was found for 11.6.7.1.
notes: The former product page redirects to Wondershare UniConverter, and the original Aimersoft DMG is still reachable.

name: KMyMoney
product: KMyMoney personal finance manager by KDE

evidence.says: The project says its Mac CI packages are broken and seeks a maintainer for them.
The project announced the 5.2.2 release while separately directing users to platform-specific download information.
A contributor describes compiling the development tree locally for Apple Silicon.

limitation: The KDE Mac download page reports broken CI builds and no current official Mac artifact was found.
notes: KMyMoney remains active on other platforms. A KDE Discuss thread demonstrates a locally compiled ARM build of the 5.2 development tree.

name: Game Capture HD
product: Elgato Game Capture HD recording and streaming software for macOS

evidence.says: Elgato explicitly limits the Game Capture HD macOS software line to Intel Macs and says Apple Silicon is unsupported.
Elgato's macOS release archive lists 2.11.14 as the newest Game Capture HD release and links its ZIP.
The inspected 2.11.14 build 3885 contains an x86_64-only Game Capture HD.app/Contents/MacOS/Game Capture HD executable and the exact bundle ID.

limitation: The ZIP's server modification date does not establish the release date.
notes: Elgato Studio is the vendor's separate current capture app.

name: TRITON
product: KORG Collection TRITON standalone synthesizer by KORG

evidence.says: KORG lists TRITON 1.4.7 as its newest release and documents that native Apple Silicon support for the Mac edition began in 1.3.7.
KORG's current Collection specifications list native Apple Silicon support.
KORG's TRITON manual identifies a standalone synthesizer alongside its plug-in formats.

limitation: The changelog update is dated July 17, 2026 and gives no distinct release date for version 1.4.7.
notes: This record covers KORG Collection TRITON, a standalone software instrument.

name: smcFanControl
product: Eidac smcFanControl (Hendrik Holtmann)

evidence.says: The official GitHub release API dates 2.6 to October 16, 2016 and identifies its release ZIP as smcfancontrol_2_6.zip.
Inspection of smcFanControl.app/Contents/MacOS/smcFanControl in the official 2.6 ZIP found only a Mach-O x86_64 slice and the app plist confirmed com.eidac.smcFanControl2.
Homebrew identifies stable version 2.6 as a build for Intel macOS that requires Rosetta 2 on Apple Silicon.
A user of 2.6 reports successful fan control on an M1 13-inch MacBook Pro, while another reports failure on a fanless M1 MacBook Air.

limitation: Fan control on newer Apple Silicon models was not verified.

name: 3DWOX Desktop
product: Sindoh 3DWOX Desktop 3D printer slicer

evidence.says: Sindoh's manual identifies 3DWOX Desktop as its slicer for the 3DWOX family of printers.
Mac Informer records a Sindoh macOS app named 3DWOX Desktop but gives no confirmed version.
The original scan identifies the exact Sindoh bundle but does not provide a Mac version or binary architecture.

limitation: No current official Mac download, release version, or Apple Silicon compatibility documentation was located.

name: TH-D74 Programmer
product: RT Systems KRS-D74 radio programming software for the Kenwood TH-D74 (Mac)

evidence.says: RT Systems sells a Mac version of its TH-D74 radio programming software.
RT Systems lists the TH-D74 among its Mac programmers and says the programmer family was updated for the end of Intel app support, without naming the current TH-D74 build version.
The vendor's electronic download portal requires purchaser information before providing software.

limitation: No versioned architecture documentation or public current Mac package was available for this model.

name: ScannerApp
product: Brother ScannerApp, Brother's standalone Mac scanner utility

evidence.says: Contemporaneous coverage identifies Brother ScannerApp as a standalone Mac App Store release for scanning from Brother devices and links its App Store ID 912659472.
Apple's official lookup API returns zero records for the app's original U.S. App Store ID.
Apple's official lookup API also returns zero records for the Japanese storefront.
The original app metadata identifies version 1.0 and the exact com.brother.ScannerApp bundle.

limitation: No vendor retirement notice or final executable architecture was located.
notes: Brother ScannerApp was a separate download from Brother iPrint&Scan.

name: Volanta
product: Orbx Volanta desktop personal flight tracker

evidence.says: Homebrew identifies 1.19.2 and the orbx.volanta preference domain for the current Mac download served by Orbx's Volanta CDN.
Desktop Insights records its binary analysis of Orbx's 1.19.2 Mac build as universal arm64 and x86_64 and dates the release to September 17, 2026.

limitation: Architecture is from a published analysis of the binary that was not independently inspected in this audit.

name: WaveLab Pro 10.0
product: WaveLab Pro 10 for macOS by Steinberg Media Technologies

evidence.says: Steinberg hosts WaveLab Pro 10 in its legacy downloads and dates the 10.0.70 Mac installer to March 23, 2021.
Steinberg qualifies WaveLab Pro 10.0.70 for Apple Silicon through Rosetta 2 on macOS Big Sur, with slower movement of certain windows.
Steinberg says older products absent from its current table will receive no more updates; the WaveLab table lists Pro versions 12 and 13.

limitation: Steinberg's Rosetta 2 qualification covers macOS Big Sur. Later macOS versions were not verified for WaveLab Pro 10.
notes: The final release was Intel and ran through Rosetta 2. Newer major versions are separate releases.

name: Civilization V Campaign Edition
product: Sid Meier’s Civilization V, Aspyr’s Mac App Store edition formerly titled Campaign Edition

evidence.says: Apple's catalog returns com.aspyr.civ5campaign as Civilization V 1.4.2 and dates this release to December 2, 2019.
Aspyr’s Mac App Store listing gives Intel processor requirements and retains the Campaign Edition name in the version history.
The submitted 1.4.2 build for this bundle has an x86 scan.

limitation: The current store version matches the x86 scan, but first-hand Rosetta reports I could verify identified the Steam build or omitted the distribution channel.
notes: Apple still uses the original com.aspyr.civ5campaign bundle identifier under the Civilization V storefront title.

name: NemuPlayer
product: NemuPlayer, NetEase’s older Mac build of the MuMu Android emulator

evidence.says: The historic listing identifies version 1.9.55 with bundle ID com.netease.nemu and reports x86.
NetEase describes the current MuMuPlayer for Mac as an emulator exclusively for Apple Silicon Macs.
NetEase maintains a separate version history for its current Apple Silicon Mac emulator.

limitation: No current official package or support statement was found for com.netease.nemu, and no vendor source established that the current Apple Silicon product is the same app bundle.
notes: The latest submission is the Intel-era 1.9.55 build. NetEase's current MuMuPlayer for Mac has separate release notes describing an Apple Silicon product.

name: AmpliTube 4
product: AmpliTube 4 standalone amp and effects modeling app by IK Multimedia

evidence.says: IK Multimedia announces AmpliTube 5 as the replacement generation and offers an upgrade to qualifying AmpliTube 4 purchasers.
The digital-delivery listing for the original product is marked no longer available.
The 4.10 scan for the exact AmpliTube 4 standalone bundle reports x86.
A first-hand Apple Silicon test reports that AmpliTube 4 worked through Rosetta 2.

limitation: 4.10 is the newest original standalone build I could document. The Rosetta report does not specify its exact build or separately identify standalone versus plug-in use.
notes: The documented 4.10 bundle is Intel-only. IK Multimedia replaced the 4 series with AmpliTube 5 and offered eligible 4 owners an upgrade.

name: UVIWorkstation
product: UVI Workstation, now named UVI Player, by UVI

evidence.says: UVI describes UVI Player as the renamed UVI Workstation and confirms that it continues to run standalone.
UVI's scripting reference and changelog name version 5.0.2 and are dated November 9, 2026.
The vendor's existing UVI Workstation Mac download endpoint now redirects to UVI Player 5.0.2, whose package metadata is dated November 9, 2026.
Soundware publisher Acousticsamples labels that same Mac download a universal Intel and Apple silicon binary and lists standalone among the available formats.

limitation: The release architecture is documented by a UVI soundware publisher and the large DMG was not inspected.
notes: UVI continues the same player under its new name with the next major version.

name: Toontrack solo
product: Toontrack solo standalone host for Superior Drummer 2 and EZdrummer 1 by Toontrack

evidence.says: Toontrack's 2011 notes name 1.3.2 and describe older Mac builds without giving the architecture for the subsequently scanned 1.3.2.1 build.
Toontrack identifies solo as the standalone host for Superior Drummer 2 and EZdrummer 1.
An Apple Silicon macOS 15 user reports that Toontrack Solo loads Superior Drummer 2 with important limitations and supplies neither the exact Solo build nor its architecture.

limitation: No current vendor download or explicit architecture for the exact 1.3.2.1 Mac build was verified.
notes: The vendor's archived 2011 reference to Rosetta predates Apple Silicon and does not establish Rosetta 2 behavior.

name: Wireless Workbench 6
product: Wireless Workbench 6 RF coordination and device management desktop app by Shure

evidence.says: Shure archives 6.15.4 from October 31, 2023 as the last 6.x release and lists subsequent development under version 7.
Shure's current product page promotes Wireless Workbench 7 as its RF coordination app.
Shure directs users with legacy UHF-R hardware to the older 6.15 branch.

limitation: Shure's 6.15.4 compatibility notes list Apple Silicon through macOS 14 without identifying the executable architecture, and the package was over the inspection size limit.
notes: An archived download remains available for legacy hardware. The vendor's archive explicitly documents the universal binary in 7.1.0.

name: RapidMiner Studio
product: Rapidminer AI Studio, formerly RapidMiner Studio and Altair AI Studio (Siemens)

evidence.says: The vendor's 2024.0.0 changelog documents that RapidMiner Studio was renamed Altair AI Studio.
Siemens's versioned release notes date the Rapidminer AI Studio 2609 release to October 2, 2026.
The vendor's public downloads page script identifies the Mac ARM download separately from the other Mac download.
The official latest Mac ARM URL resolves to the live rapidminer-ai-studio-osx-aarch-2609.0000.0002.dmg package.
The versioned Apple disk image for the current Mac ARM release responded successfully on the vendor's distribution server.

notes: The older Homebrew ai-studio cask names version 2026.1.1 and its Intel installer. The vendor's Apple Silicon release notes first confirm a native Mac app in 2025.1.0.
